title: Shiraishi An — Top-Notch Server!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Here's your coffee!

rows.Speaker: Customer A
rows.Line:
Thanks, An.
Hey, is that girl singing right now your new partner?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup, she is. Her name's Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Customer A
rows.Line:
Sweet.
She's got a great voice.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I know, right?
And also...
In-Store Music Venue

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
Thank you for listening!

rows.Speaker: Customer B
rows.Line:
That was really good!
Can you do one more for us?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh?!
A-As in an encore?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Th-Then...
Okay, I'll sing one more song!

rows.Speaker: Customer B
rows.Line: Now we're talking!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She's gotten used to the stage lately and gained a lot of courage.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She can now take impromptu requests and even sing along with musicians who jump in without warning!

rows.Speaker: Customer A
rows.Line: You're really happy about your partner's progress, eh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Of course I am! Ah...
Welcome to the shop! Feel free to take the window seat.

rows.Speaker: Customer C
rows.Line:
An, can I have my usual?
Make it two!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Two coffee blends, got it!
By the way, I saw your live show the other day. It was awesome!

rows.Speaker: Customer C
rows.Line: Really? Thanks for that!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to your next one!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, good to see you today too.
I heard one of your group members got hurt. Is everything okay now?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oops, I'll clear the dishes here for you.
Your performance the other day was so entertaining! Thanks for that!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, hi, Kohane!
You sang really well today, as usual!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An, you're just amazing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You were chatting with each individual customer while doing your work...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha, it's nothing fantastic at all.
You're the amazing one here. I saw the audience asking for an encore!

rows.Speaker: Customer D
rows.Line:
Yup, you really are amazing!
I mean, An was the one who approached you and asked to be partners, right?

rows.Speaker: Customer D
rows.Line: So many people around here have been trying to team up with An, but she never accepted any of their offers.

rows.Speaker: Customer E
rows.Line:
Yeah, and that's why you're amazing.
How'd you manage to win An over?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh? I-I didn't do anything to win...
I mean, um...

rows.Speaker: Customer D
rows.Line:
Hey, I know!
Why don't you sing with my group instead?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wh-Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Customer D
rows.Line: You sing so well, and if you join my group, An may come sing together with us, too...

rows.Speaker: Customer D
rows.Line: So, please! Join my group!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... Well, but...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright, that's enough!
You're putting her on the spot.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane's MY partner, and I'm not letting her go anywhere.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A-An...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I may have to ban you from the shop if you keep cajoling her like this. Remember that.

rows.Speaker: Customer E
rows.Line: Oh dear... I have no choice but to back down, then.

rows.Speaker: Customer D
rows.Line: See, you must be really amazing for An to defend you like that...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Th-Thank you for your compliment!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Sorry about that, Kohane.
They weren't trying to be mean.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-It's okay.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
An, thank you for saying that about me.
I'll do my very best to live up to your expectations!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Come on, you don't have to stress yourself about that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's more important for you to decide on what's best for yourself, instead of thinking about what I want, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's the Kohane I want to sing with.
So let's do our best together, alright?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay! Please continue to lend me your support, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You bet I will!
